features.name: Hospital Registration & Login
features.description: Hospital authentication with registration and login functionality. Includes JWT token-based authentication.

features.name: Ambulance Registration & Login
features.description: Ambulance authentication with registration and login functionality. Includes JWT token-based authentication.

features.name: Hospital Dashboard
features.description: Hospital dashboard showing statistics (total doctors, available doctors, pending requests, accepted requests), recent emergency requests, and quick access to other features.

features.name: Ambulance Dashboard
features.description: Ambulance dashboard showing statistics (hospitals available, selected hospital info, ambulance information), location tracking status, and quick actions.

features.name: Doctor Management
features.description: CRUD operations for doctors including add, edit, delete, and toggle availability. Manage doctor profiles with qualifications, specializations, and schedules.

features.name: Emergency Management
features.description: Create, update, and track emergency requests. Real-time emergency notifications between ambulances and hospitals.

features.name: Hospital Search with Map
features.description: Interactive map showing nearby hospitals with real-time availability. Filter hospitals by specialization and distance. Select hospitals for emergency notifications.

features.name: Real-time Notifications
features.description: Socket.io based real-time notifications for emergency requests, hospital updates, doctor availability changes, and location updates.

features.name: Location Tracking
features.description: Real-time ambulance location tracking using browser geolocation API. Updates location on server and broadcasts via Socket.io.

features.name: Profile Management
features.description: View and edit profile information for both hospitals and ambulances.

features.name: Authentication Context
features.description: Centralized authentication state management with login, logout, token verification, and role-based access control.

features.name: Protected Routes
features.description: Role-based route protection ensuring only authorized users (hospital or ambulance) can access their respective dashboards.

features.name: Statistics Dashboard
features.description: System-wide statistics including hospital count, doctor count, and other metrics.

features.name: UI Components
features.description: Reusable UI components including navigation bars, loaders, headers, footers, and error pages.

features.name: Styling System
features.description: Comprehensive CSS styling including glass-morphism UI, responsive design, dashboard enhancements, and improved text visibility.

features.name: API Services
features.description: Centralized API configuration and service layer for making HTTP requests to the backend.

features.name: Server Configuration
features.description: Express server setup with CORS, middleware, routes, database connection, and error handling.

features.name: Database Models
features.description: MongoDB models for hospitals, ambulances, doctors, emergencies, notifications, and users with schema definitions and methods.

features.name: Route Handlers
features.description: Express route handlers for authentication, hospitals, ambulances, doctors, emergencies, notifications, and stats.

features.name: Page Routing
features.description: React Router configuration for all application pages including public and protected routes.
